company_name: Hokkaido University, Novel Materials Hybrid Engineering Laboratory
semiconductor_relevance: Medium — The laboratory develops copper nanoparticle systems for die bonding and wiring applications, which are relevant to semiconductor manufacturing.
summary: Hokkaido University's Novel Materials Hybrid Engineering Laboratory specializes in developing low-temperature sinterable copper nanoparticle systems, including pastes and inks, for semiconductor applications. Their research focuses on hybrid materials that integrate metals, semiconductors, and polymers, aiming to advance materials science and innovate new applications within the semiconductor value chain.
capabilities: Copper nanoparticle paste and ink for die bonding
Composite paste systems for copper nanoparticles
technical_expertise: Surface and interface control in materials
